Use `faker_qa/credit_card_provider_empty_types_indexerror_uncaught/files/testcase.py`, class `TestCreditCardProviderEmptyTypesIndexErrorUncaughtQA`, method `test_credit_card_provider_empty_types_indexerror_uncaught_case`.
